summary: The spec matches PM request A-53 in full: three server-enforced choices (3h default, until_17 Asia/Bangkok, 7d max), audit records the choice, end early stays, th/en strings, tests for the 3 choices and refused values, Review B required, no deploy, master by 2026-11-18. Every file:line citation in spec section 3 was spot-checked against HEAD (26cdcda80) and is accurate. Security points (7-day code validity, OQ-1 code-only classes, until_17 refusal at 17:00 Bangkok, refusal before the old session closes, unchanged rate limits) are each covered by a named Red case or by the Review B scope of task 1.12. Zero-decision holds: OQ-1 and OQ-2 carry stated defaults and D-6 decides the date display. Every task names its files and its test command; all named-file Vitest commands carry --maxWorkers=1; heavy steps go through heavy-run.sh with HEAVY_PRIORITY=p2 HEAVY_RUN_TIMEOUT_S=1800. Owner-word quotes use roles; only the allowed name Daniel appears. One Major and three Nits; no Blocker.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] plan task 1.5: The plan anchors the 'until_17' throw "before class-session.ts:86", but ensureStudentCredentials at class-session.ts:84 runs before line 86 and can insert credential rows, which conflicts with AC-3's "inserts no row". Rationale: the plan should anchor the check before the first row write (before line 84), so a refused start changes no row even when the class has students without credentials.

F2 [Nit] plan task 1.1: The real-db instruction "keep the real-db file unchanged unless it already has a start call, then extend it" has its condition true at HEAD (student-login.real-db.test.ts calls startClassSession at lines 70, 82, 89-90, 97-99, 111, 145, 166, 216, 269), but the plan names no cases to add there. Rationale: Red could read "then extend it" as an open-ended order; the plan should name the extension or state that the existing calls need no change.

F3 [Nit] plan task 1.9: The key ClassLogin.session.lifetimeHelp7d is listed "only when the text is kept after Review B", so the string set of task 1.8 depends on a later review outcome. Rationale: the plan should state the default (add it now, remove it if Review B refuses) so Green stays deterministic.

F4 [Nit] spec OQ-3 and plan task 1.7: D-6 decides that an expiry on a later Bangkok date shows the date, but the exact format is left to the implementer ("follows the existing useIntlFormatter"); the panel test checks only that a date shows. Rationale: this is a presentational detail, not a product decision; naming the formatter option would close it.

paraphrase.proposes: This track lets the teacher choose the class sign-in session lifetime when class sign-in starts: "3 hours" (the default, as today), "Until 17:00 today" (Asia/Bangkok), or "7 days". The server enforces the choice enum (7 days is the maximum), computes the expiry itself, records the choice in the class_start audit line, and refuses 'until_17' at 17:00 Bangkok or later before any row changes. Ending early and restarting stay as today; the picture password, the rate limits, and the card token logic do not change. One phase changes the contract, the domain function, the teacher panel, and the th/en strings, with tests, Review B (security), and a merge to master by 2026-11-18; no deploy.
paraphrase.current_system: Per the spec, startClassSession in packages/domain/src/student-login/class-session.ts fixes the lifetime at 3 hours (CLASS_SESSION_LIFETIME_MS, used only at line 124): it authorizes the teacher, closes any earlier open session of the class, inserts one session row with the code hash, and writes a class_start audit line with sessionId and expiresAt. The class code lookup and the QR card sign-in both join that same session row (closedAt IS NULL, expiresAt > now), so code and cards share one lifetime; there is no separate card lifetime. A class with the picture password off lets the code alone start a code_only student session. The start contract today has only classroomId, StudentLoginErrorCode has no validation code, the startClass handler is a thin teacherHandler that returns 400 "Invalid input" on a schema failure, and the teacher panel posts { classroomId } and shows the expiry as hour and minute only.
